text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Britain renews support for Kuwait and Gulf Arab states. British Foreign Office Minister Derek Fatchett arrived in Kuwait on Monday as part of a Gulf Arab tour.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange to slightly amend rules governing the listing of firms on the bourse.

- Kuwait and Jordan's foreign ministers discussed full restoration of relations. Ties between the two countries were strained after what Kuwait saw as Amman's sympathy with Iraq during its 1990-91 occupation of the oil-rich Gulf state.

- Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) to make first flight to Amman since the 1990 Iraqi invasion on July 9. KAC and Royal Jordanian Airlines agreed this week equally share four flights a week between the two Arab capitals.
- Kuwait's Oil Minister Isa al-Mazeedi leaves to Vienna on Monday to attend meetings of the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
- About 321 expatriates deported after failing health tests.
